# `csharp_style_namespace_declarations`

Convert block namespaces to file-scoped. IDE0161. Applied without a compilation.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `block_scoped` |  |
| `file_scoped` |  |

**Default:** `(as written)`

## Example

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
using System;

namespace N
{
    public class Widget
    {
        public void Run() { }
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
using System;

namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Run() { }
}
```
:::

::::

*Setting shown: `csharp_style_namespace_declarations = file_scoped`*

### `csharp_style_namespace_declarations = block_scoped`

```ini
csharp_style_namespace_declarations = block_scoped
```

```csharp
using System;

namespace N
{
    public class Widget
    {
        public void Run() { }
    }
}
```
